scope: Complete supplied 497-message incremental quest packet; original native text versions checked read-only. Twelve existing profiles/places extended and two event stories added.

source.unreviewed: Attachments and inaccessible threads; no claim of exhaustive older archive review.

editorialDecisions: Explicit owner canon decisions and established quest narrator outcomes govern. Character threats, reports, recollections and theories remain attributed. This packet supplies two separate continuous quests, not a continuation of every earlier regional scene.

All 497 supplied message bodies match the native cache exactly, treating the upload’s no-text placeholder as empty content. None of their IDs was already cited in canonical content. All 393 newly cited native versions match; receipt matching does not certify every attachment, inaccessible thread or older archive. The packet reports inaccessible archived threads; no server-wide completeness is claimed.

Pin is an established alias of the single canonical Pelegia player identity. Explicit scene names support these actions, which extend Pelegia’s existing profile rather than the legacy census copy. All aliases remain; no controller mapping or raw reply wrapper is published. Oya’s existing directory identity remains; no generic merchant, construct, seasonal figure or painting subject gains an invented personal page.

Hana’s death and burned body are explicit narrator outcomes. They do not resolve her mother, the relation between changing voices/doll/larger form, or the painted Gardener. No certain sole killing blow, finished burial or absent companion’s fate is invented. Earlier disappearance history remains in place, with current summaries updated.

The Children of Viota’s claim of Minerva’s captivity is retained alongside Fenwick’s relayed safety report and her earlier Nerithra self-report. Neither the threat nor the older message verifies her complete present circumstances, completed ritual or return.

The Tik receives ordinary replacement parts but is not repaired fully. Mending does not recover deliberately erased words; a map failure is inconclusive when the map is incomplete. Proposed preservation illusions remain a proposal. The Pilgrims mural uses narrator prose only; the final Gardener title is not an identity disclosure. No attachment pixels or unseen videos are interpreted.

The constructs attack a Chain; Ithilrûnë’s recognition and the material guess do not prove sender, metal or common master. Her meteors also strike the Chain and knock companions down. Both constructs fall. The inspected Chain is weakened and contaminated but still suppresses Guidance; this is not universal Chain failure.

The crossing follows the decision before recovery. Coralyn’s healing has limits, Pappy both helps and needs help, Sildithas’s crampons give limited purchase and movement spells last an hour. Coralyn’s changed recollection of telepathy is explicit, without declaring all powers permanently lost. No arrival at the Maw, final explanation, cure, safe return or successful return teleport is supplied.

Each quest remains on its opening day under the owner’s continuation rule: 27 October/Day968 and 29 October/Day970. Full local posting windows 27–29 and 29–30 October and exact resumption/end receipts remain distinct. The unrelated Tower petition and earlier Chain inspection keep their dates. Both new consequences are Regional, without inflating importance from cosmic terms.
